sources.location: https://doi.org/10.1083/jcb.202310030 (PMC11252447; PRIDE lists the bioRxiv preprint 10.1101/2023.09.29.559344)

claims.value: File name <date>_<GFP|TLNRD1>_R<n>_<n><k>: bait, biological repeat n, gel slice k (1-5).
claims.evidence: Protocol: gel lanes sliced into five 2-mm bands; paper: three biological repeats combined per dataset; 5 files per bait x repeat.
Paper Fig.1D: GFP pulldown in HEK293T cells expressing GFP-TLNRD1 or GFP alone; Cellosaurus identifier HEK293T.

claims.value: Q Exactive DDA HCD; trypsin; DTT/IAA; Mascot (PD 1.5) 10 ppm/0.02 Da; Carbamidomethyl C fixed, Oxidation M variable.
claims.evidence: Protocol text and raw header say Q Exactive; PRIDE's 'Orbitrap Fusion Lumos' field is contradicted.

limitations: PRIDE metadata lists Orbitrap Fusion Lumos but protocol, paper Methods and the RAW header agree on Q Exactive; annotation follows the latter.
Cell type and developmental stage are `not available`.
The pulldown is of transiently expressed GFP-tagged baits; modelled as genetic modification factor.
